summary: Full-stack testing of bill4pe. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed (auth incl. lockout/refresh/logout, register validation, settings persistence, customer CRUD, invoice GST math intra/inter-state, draft->send, partial+full payment, duplicate reference 409, dashboard stats). Frontend (Playwright on public URL): login redirect, wrong-password error alert, admin login -> dashboard with all 4 KPIs + revenue chart + recent invoices + top customers, settings save+persist after reload, customer add, invoice builder (2 line items 10x500@5% + 1x2000@18% => grand total ₹7,610.00 shown live, inter-state toggle keeps total 7610 with IGST, UPI QR preview visible), Save & Send creates invoice and navigates to detail (INV-0002), invoice detail shows UPI QR + total, partial payment reduces balance ₹6,610.00, duplicate txn reference correctly rejected (409), full payment flips balance to ₹0.00, invoices list + search + status tabs work, logout redirects to /login. Overdue seeded invoice (INV-0001 Sharma Textiles, due 2026-06-15) correctly shows Overdue badge and matches Overdue KPI ₹5,610.00.

issues: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warning during initial render; chart still renders correctly after container settles. Consider setting explicit min height on ResponsiveContainer parent.
React dev-time hydration warning: <span> inside <option> (from Emergent preview instrumentation wrappers on GST_SLABS.map). Cosmetic/dev-only, does not affect prod. No user impact.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~630-line module; recommend splitting into routers (auth/settings/customers/invoices/dashboard) and models modules for maintainability as feature-set grows.

eff_status uses today = utcnow().date().isoformat() with string comparison against due_date - works because both are ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD strings, but could break if due_date ever stored as datetime. Consider normalizing on write.
compute_totals splits tax as half/tax-half which can leave 1p rounding on the SGST side (e.g., 305/305 OK here, but on 5.03 tax you'd get 2.51/2.52). Acceptable for GST rounding rules.
Login lockout uses request.client.host+email as key; behind a proxy/ingress this may not be the real client IP. Consider trusting X-Forwarded-For when appropriate.
get_current_user reads Bearer token from Authorization header as fallback but /auth/logout does not require auth - fine, but /auth/refresh accepts refresh cookie only; acceptable.
Frontend charts container: give explicit height to avoid recharts width(-1) warning on first paint.
